verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so asking whether users can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or privacy controls. The security page covers role-based permissions and edit-history audit logs, which are adjacent controls and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
